questions.question: What do broken double white lines at a junction mean?
options: You must give way to the major road
You have priority over oncoming cars
You must always stop for five seconds
questions.explanation: Broken double white lines mean give way to traffic on the major road.

questions.question: How should you emerge if parked cars block your view?
options: Slow down and creep forward carefully
questions.explanation: Creep forward slowly until you can see approaching traffic clearly.
